assumptions.capacity: Scenario-specific hypothetical module count/Wp from frozen roof CSVs; never actual installed A160 capacity
assumptions.tilt_orientation: Hypothetical V1-derived panel-layout settings; actual installed angles remain unknown
assumptions.loss_percent: JRC default 14% used as an explicit sensitivity assumption, not measured system losses
assumptions.technology_mounting: Illustrative crystalline silicon and free-standing ventilated rack; actual installation unknown
assumptions.weather: Historical 2017 SARAH3 radiation; selected reference calendar only. It is not the same weather sequence as the office IWEC model and must not be joined silently
assumptions.shading: PVGIS terrain horizon only; local building/plant/tree shadows and installed inverter clipping are not verified
